_schema_notes: Per-arm stats must measure spatial structure, not marginal distributions. Any scalar aggregate over a permuted quantity (e.g. a plain mean) is identical between the grounded and shuffled arms by construction; do not add such stats. Fields prefixed severity_ (severity_wet_coverage, severity_accumulation_coverage) are dataset severity/extent descriptors, not ablation-discrimination metrics -- they are structurally blind to grounded-vs-shuffled for the same reason. Use the *_depth_corr / *_seg_mi pairs for ablation discrimination (grounding_depth_corr/grounding_seg_mi for fog and snow, which have one grounding map each; veiling_/wet_/reflection_depth_corr and _seg_mi for rain, which has three independently-grounded components). All mutual information values are in bits (log2), not nats.
